outcome: Maternal characteristics (gestational age at delivery, BMI)
cohort: Pregnant women who underwent elective labor induction at a single tertiary care center between June 2020 and October 2022.
finding: During the COVID-19 pandemic, more pregnancies underwent labor induction under modified protocols, resulting in a significant reduction in cesarean sections.
mod_finding: A significant reduction in cesarean sections was observed during the pandemic period, and advanced maternal age and primiparity were identified as independent risk factors for cesarean delivery.
